title: Rumored crash in Chinese territory

tellings.quote: And I've heard a lot of rumors when I did business in China, which I did for years. >> Yeah. >> With the Chinese government that there was something that crashed >> in Chinese territory. I think the Russians got it though.

plain: Something is said to have crashed on Chinese territory, and the Russians are said to have ended up with it. Peter Levenda, an author who writes on intelligence and the occult, tells Michels he heard many such rumours over years of doing business with the Chinese government, and that the Russian part is his own guess.
